data.company_overview: Postman offers an AI-native API platform that lets engineers develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs at enterprise scale. The platform streamlines the entire API lifecycle and supports collaboration across organizations.
data.target_audience: Developers and engineering teams building, testing, and managing APIs, from individual developers to large enterprises.

data.company_overview: Supabase is an open‑source Postgres development platform that offers a full Postgres database with built‑in authentication, realtime, storage, edge functions, and vector embeddings. It enables developers and enterprises to build, scale, and secure applications quickly.
data.target_audience: Supabase primarily serves developers and product teams—including startups, enterprise innovation teams, and AI builders—who need a scalable, secure backend platform.

data.company_overview: Vapi provides a platform for building, deploying, and managing advanced voice AI agents, offering low‑latency, scalable infrastructure and enterprise‑grade features. The solution targets developers and large organizations that need reliable, customizable voice interactions.
data.target_audience: Vapi serves enterprises and developers building voice AI agents across industries such as automotive, healthcare, insurance, and more.
